description: Stop a running work session and record its time, from its start to now, against the run. In the app, with nothing named, stops the signed-in worker's own session (User role), as their my-work page does. Naming sessionId, or a worker (id or full name) whose running session to stop, stops someone else's session as the labor planner screen does and needs Admin; connectors must name one. A session already stopped is refused. Preview first; the in-app assistant gets a confirm card.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

sessionId.description: The work session id (GUID), from get_labor_work_day or get_labor_operation.

worker.description: A worker id (GUID) or full name whose running session to stop.

name: stop_labor_session
title: Stop Labor Session
